segments.text: Lesson 41
segments.translation: 第41课

segments.text: Illusions of pastoral peace
segments.translation: 宁静乡村的幻象

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: What particular anxiety spoils the country dweller's visit to the theatre?
segments.translation: 什么样的特别焦虑破坏了乡村居民去剧院观看演出的心情？

segments.text: The quiet life of the country has never appealed to me.
segments.translation: 乡村宁静的生活从来没有吸引过我。

segments.text: City born and city bred,
segments.translation: 我在城市出生并在城市长大，

segments.text: I have always regarded the country as something you look at through a train window, or something you occasionally visit during the weekend.
segments.translation: 我总把乡村看作是那种你透过火车窗户往外看的东西，或者是你偶尔在周末去访问的地方。

segments.text: Most of my friends live in the city, yet they always go into raptures at the mere mention of the country.
segments.translation: 我的大多数朋友都住在城市，然而只要一提到乡村，他们总是欣喜若狂。

segments.text: Though they extol the virtues of the peaceful life,
segments.translation: 虽然他们赞美宁静生活的种种好处，

segments.text: only one of them has ever gone to live in the country and he was back in town within six months.
segments.translation: 但他们中只有一个曾去乡村生活过，而且他在6个月内就回到了城里。

segments.text: Even he still lives under the illusion that country life is somehow superior to town life.
segments.translation: 甚至连他也仍然生活在一种幻觉中，即乡村生活在某种程度上优于城市生活。

segments.text: He is forever talking about the friendly people, the clean atmosphere, the closeness to nature and the gentle pace of living.
segments.translation: 他总是谈论那里友善的人们、清新的空气、贴近自然以及缓慢的生活节奏。

segments.text: Nothing can be compared, he maintains, with the first cockcrow, the twittering of birds at dawn,
segments.translation: 他坚持认为，没有任何东西能与第一声鸡啼、黎明时鸟儿的唧唧喳喳、

segments.text: the sight of the rising sun glinting on the trees and pastures.
segments.translation: 以及初升的太阳在树木和牧场上闪烁的景象相比。

segments.text: This idyllic pastoral scene is only part of the picture.
segments.translation: 这种田园诗般的乡村风光只是画面的一部分。

segments.text: My friend fails to mention the long and friendless winter evenings in front of the TV--virtually the only form of entertainment.
segments.translation: 我的朋友没有提到在电视机前度过的漫长而孤独的冬夜——这几乎是唯一的娱乐形式。

segments.text: He says nothing about the poor selection of goods in the shops,
segments.translation: 他绝口不提商店里可供选择的商品太少，

segments.text: or about those unfortunate people who have to travel from the country to the city every day to get to work.
segments.translation: 也不提那些每天不得不从农村赶到城市上班的倒霉蛋。

segments.text: Why people are prepared to tolerate a four-hour journey each day for the dubious privilege of living in the country is beyond me.
segments.translation: 为什么人们愿意为了在农村生活那种靠不住的益处而忍受每天4小时的旅程，这我实在无法理解。

segments.text: They could be saved so much misery and expense if they chose to live in the city where they rightly belong.
segments.translation: 如果他们选择住在理应属于他们的城市，他们就可以省去许多痛苦和开销。

segments.text: If you can do without the few pastoral pleasures of the country, you will find the city can provide you with the best that life can offer.
segments.translation: 如果你能不要农村那点儿田园乐趣，你会发现城市能为你提供生活所能给予的最好的东西。

segments.text: You never have to travel miles to see your friends.
segments.translation: 你永远不必为了看朋友而跑上好几英里。

segments.text: They invariably live nearby and are always available for an informal chat or an evening's entertainment.
segments.translation: 他们总是住在附近，随时可以进行非正式的聊天或享受晚上的娱乐活动。

segments.text: Some of my acquaintances in the country come up to town once or twice a year to visit the theatre as a special treat.
segments.translation: 我的一些在农村的熟人一年进城一两次，把去剧院看戏当作一种特殊的款待。

segments.text: For them this is a major operation which involves considerable planning.
segments.translation: 对他们来说，这是一次重大的行动，涉及周密的计划。

segments.text: As the play draws to its close, they wonder whether they will ever catch that last train home.
segments.translation: 当戏快结束时，他们会担心是否还能赶上那趟回家的末班车。

segments.text: The city dweller never experiences anxieties of this sort.
segments.translation: 城里人从来不会有这类焦虑。

segments.text: The latest exhibitions, films, or plays are only a short bus ride away.
segments.translation: 最新的展览、电影或戏剧只需坐一小段公共汽车即可到达。

segments.text: Shopping, too, is always a pleasure.
segments.translation: 购物也总是件令人愉快的事。

segments.text: There is so much variety that you never have to make do with second best.
segments.translation: 商品琳琅满目，以致你永远不必为了二流货而迁就。

segments.text: Country people run wild when they go shopping in the city and stagger home loaded with as many of the exotic items as they can carry.
segments.translation: 当农村人进城购物时，他们会变得疯狂，步履蹒跚地带着尽可能多搬得动的稀罕物品回家。

segments.text: Nor is the city without its moments of beauty.
segments.translation: 城市也并非没有美丽的时刻。

segments.text: There is something comforting about the warm glow shed by advertisements on cold wet winter nights.
segments.translation: 在寒冷潮湿的冬夜，广告牌散发出的温暖光芒让人感到宽慰。

segments.text: Few things could be more impressive than the peace that descends on deserted city streets at weekends
segments.translation: 少有比这更令人印象深刻的了 tendencias，当成千上万每天进城上班的人都躲进他们农村的家里时，

segments.text: when the thousands that travel to work every day are tucked away in their homes in the country.
segments.translation: 周末在空旷的城市街道上降临的宁静。

segments.text: It has always been a mystery to me why city dwellers, who appreciate all these things,
segments.translation: 对我来说，为什么那些欣赏这一切的城市居民，

segments.text: obstinately pretend that they would prefer to live in the country.
segments.translation: 还要固执地假装他们更愿意住在农村，这一直是个谜。
